Package frc.robot.commands

Class ControllerRumble

java.lang.Object
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Command
frc.robot.commands.ControllerRumble
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable
public class ControllerRumble extends edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Command
Rumbles a controller's left motor for as long as the command is scheduled, then stops both motors when the command ends.

Used as haptic feedback for game-state events (e.g., "shooter is up to speed"). Bind this as a whileTrue trigger so it automatically cancels when the condition clears.

Asymmetry note: execute() sets only the left rumble motor to full; end(boolean) zeroes both left and right. This is intentional â€” on some controllers a previous command or button binding may have set the right motor. Zeroing both in end() guarantees the controller is quiet regardless of prior state.
